How much does it cost to run an american fridge freezer?

A typical american fridge freezer uses about 400 kWh a year (250–600 kWh depending on size and efficiency). At the current price cap rate that's about £105 a year, or £8.77 a month.

Cost per year
£105
About £8.77 a month at 26.32p/kWh.

Standing charge not included.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Use the smallest appliance that does the job: a microwave or air fryer usually beats the oven for small portions.
  • Turn things off at the wall if they sit on standby all day.
  • Check the energy label when you replace an appliance; running costs over its life often outweigh the price difference.

Questions

How much does it cost to run an american fridge freezer per month?

About £8.77 a month for a model using 400 kWh a year, at 26.32p/kWh.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my american fridge freezer's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
